question: Where can I get a list of public electric vehicle charging points in Spain, with location, operator, power (kW) and number of connectors?

answer.summary: Yes: the Ministry (MITECO) keeps a national census of public-access charging points (RIPREE), republished daily as a DATEX II XML feed on the DGT National Access Point. The feed has 12,114 sites, 35,905 points and 43,097 connectors with exact coordinates, operator (CPO) and max power per connector. Reserve: no live availability or price in it; completeness against the real network is not checked.
main_caveats: Power unit differs by file: DATEX maxPowerAtSocket is in watts (350000.0 = 350 kW); RIPREE CSV/XML carries text like '350,00 kW'. Divide by 1000 only for the DATEX feed.
Rows are not points: RIPREE CSV/XML has one row per connector (43,098); DATEX nests connectors in 35,905 refill points inside 12,114 sites. 4,999 points have 2+ connectors.
Only public-access points reported by registered CPOs are included. Availability and price (needed only for points of 43 kW or more) are not in these files; REVE shows them as a viewer only.
Completeness against the real network is unverified: registered operators number 163 and no independent total was opened. Per-site lastUpdated dates range from 2023 to 2026.
In the DATEX feed postcodes lose the leading zero (3,388 sites have under five digits) and typeOfSite is missing for 1,217 sites; the RIPREE CSV/XML keep the zero.
answer.confidence_reason: Both official files were downloaded and parsed in full; counts agree (12,114 sites, 35,905 points). Only completeness against the real network was not checked.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL --max-time 300 -o electrolineras.xml "https://nap.dgt.es/datex2/v3/miterd/EnergyInfrastructureTablePublication/electrolineras.xml"   # 83.7 MB; then python3 -I with xml.etree.ElementTree.iterparse over {http://datex2.eu/schema/3/energyInfrastructure}energyInfrastructureSite
how_to_use.example_result: Site 2023002088 'Centro Porsche Baleares CP2', lat 39.5948, lon 2.63586, 'Dirección: Camí dels Reis 166', 'Municipio: Palma', operator 'Motor Box Mallorca SL' (ES*915), refillPoint ES*915*EES00025600000020000001, connector iec62196T2COMBO mode4DC cableMode3, maxPowerAtSocket 350000.0, voltage 920.0, maximumCurrent 348.0. Whole file: 12114 sites, 35905 refillPoints, 43097 connectors.
steps: Download the XML with a plain GET (no key); the response header says max-age=60 and the NAP says 24h refresh.
Stream it with iterparse and clear each energyInfrastructureSite after reading (the file is 83.7 MB).

Per site read fac:name, loc:coordinatesForDisplay latitude/longitude, fac:operator/fac:name, the four locx:addressLine texts (strip the 'Municipio: ' style prefixes) and locx:postcode (zero-fill to 5 digits).
Per egi:refillPoint count its egi:connector children for 'number of connectors'; read maxPowerAtSocket and divide by 1000 for kW.
Sum connectors per site if you need a site total (43,097 over 12,114 sites). The whole file is Spain; no country filter needed.
reading_traps: maxPowerAtSocket is in watts: 350000.0 means 350 kW; the RIPREE CSV/XML for the same record says '350,00 kW'.
Postcode loses the leading zero (e.g. 7011 for Palma, should be 07011) in 3,388 of 12,114 sites.
egi:typeOfSite is absent in 1,217 sites; maximumCurrent absent in 8,592 connectors.
A refill point can hold several connectors (4,999 of 35,905 points have 2 to 8); the file does not say if they work at once, so do not add their powers as station capacity.
Operator is the CPO that reports the point; it may differ from the brand shown at the site or the landowner. Same company can appear under several legal names.
fac:lastUpdated is per site and runs 2023 to 2026 (2,898 sites in 2026); only publicationTime tells when the feed was built.
No live data: no availability, status or price elements exist in the file (tags counted).

problems: The NAP CKAN API (nap.dgt.es/api/3/action/package_search) answers 403 to curl; the dataset page and the feed work.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL --max-time 300 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":null,"soloConsolidado":true}' -o ripree.csv "https://energia.serviciosmin.gob.es/Ripree/ExportarInstalaciones/GenerarExcel"   (XML: same body to .../GenerarXml)
how_to_use.example_result: 43098 rows. First row: Balears, Illes | Palma | ="39.5948000" | ="2.6358600" | Centro Porsche Baleares CP2 | Camí dels Reis 166 | ="07011" | Motor Box Mallorca SL | ES*915 | 2023002088 | ES*915*EES00025600000020000001 | IEC_62196_T2_COMBO | DC | Cable | 350,00 kW | 920 V | 348,00 A | 21/11/2023 11:39:04.
steps: Use the POST above (it is what the page's own CSV/XML buttons send; a GET of the Export page only returns HTML).
CSV: decode as UTF-16 (little-endian, no BOM), parse with delimiter ';', and strip the ="..." wrapper from LATITUD, LONGITUD, CODIGO POSTAL and LOCALIZACION.
Power: remove ' kW' and replace ',' with '.'. One row is one connector: group by ID. PUNTO DE RECARGA for points and by COD.INSTALACION for sites.
The XML export (UTF-8, 54.9 MB, 43098 <INSTALACION> elements with the same fields, no formula wrappers) avoids the UTF-16 and quoting problems.
reading_traps: Rows are connectors, not points: 43,098 rows, 35,905 points, 12,114 installations; ID. CONECTOR is only 1, 2, ... inside a point.
The CSV has one connector more than the DATEX feed (43,098 vs 43,097); socket type counts differ slightly (CSV has 1 TeslaConnectorEurope and 1 IEC_60309_2_three_16).
TIPOS DE SERVICIOS is empty in 38,267 rows and ACCESIBILIDAD is 'NODISPONIBLE' in 38,793 rows.
Export endpoint is an undocumented POST inside the sede page; it may change. The meaning of soloConsolidado is not explained (page code comment: to get consolidated ones).
Only active installations are exported; there is no history of removed ones.

publication_obligation.norm: Orden TED/445/2023, de 28 de abril (developing Ley 7/2021 art. 15.1 and Ley 24/2013)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: CPOs of public-access points must send static data (coordinates, address, hours, connector type, max power, format, charge mode) to MITECO and to the regions; dynamic data (price, availability) only for points of 43 kW or more. MITECO may disseminate it (art. 9) and Ley 7/2021 art. 15.1 sends it to the DGT National Access Point.
publication_obligation.frequency: Static data updated within a week of any change (art. 5.2); dynamic data at each change; annual energy sales before 1 March.

consolidated_republication.note: MITECO receives the CPO data; it exposes it as the RIPREE census export and via the DGT NAP. Per a press article, the dynamic part is shown in the REVE map (viewer only).
